purpose: have a person independent of the design judge whether it meets the requirements, quality attributes and standards, and record the decision
entry_criteria: Design document and architecture decision records exist
Requirements and quality-attribute targets are available
Reviewer did not design the system
procedure: Read the requirements and quality-attribute targets first; then review the design against them.
Examine boundaries, coupling, data ownership, failure modes, scalability and security assumptions.
Check each significant decision has a record with alternatives and consequences.
Record findings as blocker, risk or suggestion with the affected requirement.
Decide approve, approve with conditions or reject, and record the reasoning.
Track conditions to completion and re-review changes that affect a decision.
acceptance_criteria: Each finding names the requirement or attribute at risk
Every significant decision has a record with alternatives
The decision and its reasons are recorded
Reviewer is independent of the designer

validation.check: trace each quality-attribute target to the part of the design that satisfies it
validation.expect: every target maps to a design element or a recorded risk

validation.check: check each blocker finding has an owner and a resolution date

failure_modes.response: Redo the review against the requirements

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Review of a new order service finds one shared database table written by two services. It is rated a blocker for data ownership; the design is changed so one service owns the table and the other reads through an API.
